svg.title: Project-Drive direct physics telemetry
svg.desc: Three charts, derived without smoothing from the direct DriveTelemetry CSV: speed, driver controls, and aerodynamic force over twelve seconds.
svg.text: Actual 12.0 s VehicleSolver run • 240 Hz fixed step • 60 Hz recorded samples • charted directly from the retained CSV
CPU physics telemetry visualization only — not a Frontier Vulkan renderer, Surfel-GI/ReSTIR image, or editor capture.
